verdict.rationale: The evidence documents event-triggered Workflows (e.g., auto-publishing to a status page when an incident is updated). It shows no time-based or recurring schedule for jobs or workflows. On-call 'schedules' are people rotations, not scheduled job execution, so they are a different feature and earn no credit. A one-off event trigger is not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
